featured.titleZh: 美国进行爆炸模拟，针对中国涉嫌的秘密核试验
featured.summaryZh: 美国能源部在内华达州进行了非核地下化学高爆实验，旨在提升探测低当量核爆炸的能力。美方明确将此举与华盛顿怀疑中国在2020年进行的核试验联系起来，但北京方面对此予以否认。

featured.summaryZh: 特朗普总统的亲密助手、共和党参议员史蒂夫·戴恩斯呼吁美中两国在稀土供应链等分歧问题上保持接触，不要退缩。他表示，双方在习近平主席上周访问华盛顿之前就存在问题，并将继续在峰会后进行磋商。

featured.titleZh: 中国垄断钨矿数十年，美国在哈萨克斯坦的投资能否打破这一局面？
featured.summaryZh: 美国支持的采矿项目正进入哈萨克斯坦，试图在钨矿领域与中国竞争。受北京出口管制影响，全球钨价自2025年5月以来飙升超过200%，促使各国寻求替代供应源。
featured.whyImportant: 关键矿产供应链的竞争已成为大国博弈的核心，各国正加速布局以减少对单一市场的依赖。

The two single-seat aircraft, which reached Chihhang Air Base in the eastern county of Taitung on Friday, are the first new F-16s received by the island since deliveries of its original F-16A/B fleet began in 1997. featured.titleZh: 台湾接收F-16V战机，称此举证明美方支持在习特会后依然稳固
featured.summaryZh: 尽管美国总统对另一项数十亿美元的军售计划采取了搁置态度，但台湾仍接收了两架F-16V战斗机。这是自1997年以来台湾首次接收新型F-16战机，台方将其视为美方军事支持持续的信号。
featured.whyImportant: 此举在美中台三方关系敏感时期，被视为美国对台军事承诺的象征性体现。

featured.titleZh: 巴西总统卢拉称赞中国投资者“大胆”，同时向特朗普推销稀土
featured.summaryZh: 巴西总统卢拉在选举前夕表示，中国可以作为合作伙伴为巴西带来矿产加工技术。同时，他也对美国表达了合作意愿，强调巴西希望改变仅出口原材料的现状。
featured.whyImportant: 巴西在关键矿产资源开发上寻求多元化合作，反映了全球南方国家在资源开发中争取更高附加值的战略意图。

featured.titleZh: 总统关于国家网络安全意识月的致辞
featured.summaryZh: 在数字技术飞速发展的时代，网络空间已成为美国创新与实力的前沿阵地。确保网络安全对于维护美国在金融、军事及制造业等领域的全球领先地位至关重要。
featured.whyImportant: 此举强调了美国政府将网络安全视为国家战略核心，旨在应对日益复杂的数字安全挑战。

If the trip happens, Trump’s appearance at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations meeting, expected to run from November 16-18 in Manila, will be his second consecutive appearance at the gathering during this term. Trump was in Kuala Lumpur for Asean last year and in Manila for the meeting in 2017. Sources told the...

featured.titleZh: 唐纳德·特朗普计划前往菲律宾参加东盟峰会
featured.summaryZh: 据报道，美国总统特朗普计划出席下个月在马尼拉举行的东盟峰会。此举正值华盛顿与北京在地区影响力方面展开激烈竞争之际。
featured.whyImportant: 特朗普的出席反映了美国试图加强在东南亚地区的外交存在，以平衡中国在该地区日益增长的影响力。

global.title: Bangkok at breaking point as floods turn streets into stagnant lakes
global.summary: With 40 dead and a disaster declared across all 50 city districts, experts warn extreme flooding will only worsen across south-east Asia Bangkok is used to absorbing the sudden afternoon downpours that inundate the city during the rainy season. Even streets in many central high-rise districts can briefly turn into rivers, with rats and cockroaches racing out of sewers and taking temporary refuge on trees and buildings as the subterranean world is flushed out. But every city has a breaking point, and this year rain fell so fast and so hard that whole neighbourhoods of the Thai capital have been transformed, not into rivers, but stagnant lakes. In parts of the city, roughly 300mm of rain – the equivalent of half a year of average rainfall in London – fell in about two days. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 曼谷处于崩溃边缘：洪水将街道变成死水湖
global.summaryZh: 曼谷遭遇极端降雨，全市50个区宣布进入灾难状态，已造成40人死亡。短时间内降下的巨量雨水导致城市部分地区积水严重，形成大面积死水湖。
global.whyImportant: 此次极端天气凸显了东南亚城市在面对气候变化引发的洪涝灾害时，基础设施承受能力已达到极限。

global.titleZh: 特朗普威胁称，如果韩国不支付阿拉斯加天然气管道费用，将对其加倍征收关税
global.summaryZh: 特朗普政府对韩国提出能源基础设施费用要求，并以关税作为威胁手段。与此同时，美国国内正聚焦于中期选举，民调显示民主党有望夺回国会控制权。
global.whyImportant: 此举反映了特朗普政府在外交政策中将能源利益与贸易保护主义挂钩的强硬立场，可能影响美国中期选举的选情。

global.summary: The Indian airline captain who helped thwart an apparent attempt to crash a Flydubai flight described on Friday how he fought for his life in the minutes after his co-pilot stabbed him and the plane began a steep descent. Captain Smit Machchhar, recovering in an Abu Dhabi hospital, told Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi in a televised video call that he knew he had to get back on his feet to save his passengers. “I had so many wounds. global.titleZh: FlyDubai飞行员被誉为“民族英雄”，讲述遇袭经过
global.summaryZh: 一名印度籍机长在副驾驶持刀袭击并导致飞机急剧下降时，奋力反抗并成功挽救了乘客。目前该机长正在医院接受治疗，并向印度总理讲述了事发经过。
global.whyImportant: 该事件引发了对航空安全及飞行员背景审查机制的广泛关注。

global.summary: Group ⁠of Seven countries agreed on Friday to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil from emergency reserves and pledged to refrain from energy export restrictions after pressure from US President Donald Trump. The US led a pressure campaign on the European Union to draw down emergency diesel inventories, with the Trump administration warning that failure to act could lead to a US ban on diesel exports. Such a ban could sharply reduce supplies to Europe, which has become...
global.titleZh: 在特朗普威胁后，七国集团将释放数百万桶石油和柴油储备
global.summaryZh: 在特朗普政府的压力下，七国集团同意释放1.05亿桶柴油和原油储备，并承诺不限制能源出口。此前美国曾警告若不配合，将对欧洲实施柴油出口禁令。
global.whyImportant: 此举显示了美国利用能源供应作为地缘政治筹码，迫使盟友在能源政策上与其保持一致。

global.title: Two Iranians charged over alleged plot targeting Jewish community in UK
global.summary: Man, most likely in Iran, was in contact with men arrested on the eve of Yom Kippur, police say Two Iranian men have been charged in relation to an alleged terror plot targeting Manchester’s Jewish community. ​Police say another man, most likely in Iran, was in contact with them as part of a plot to get a bomb to attack Jewish targets. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 两名伊朗人因涉嫌针对英国犹太社区的阴谋被起诉
global.summaryZh: 英国警方逮捕了两名涉嫌策划袭击曼彻斯特犹太社区的男子。调查显示，两人与一名身处伊朗的嫌疑人保持联系，企图获取炸弹进行袭击。
global.whyImportant: 该案件加剧了英国国内对宗教仇恨犯罪和跨国恐怖主义威胁的担忧。

global.title: Flydubai plane attack: co-pilot previously barred from flying by Oman over extremist views
global.summary: The Flydubai co-pilot who officials said nearly crashed a Tel Aviv-bound flight with 182 people aboard was barred from flying by his native Oman over concerns he had adopted extremist views, a person familiar with the matter said on Saturday. The co-pilot was subsequently hired by the United Arab Emirates-based airline, the person said, speaking on the condition of anonymity to discuss the ongoing investigation. It was not immediately clear to what extent he was vetted when he was hired in the...
global.titleZh: Flydubai飞机袭击事件：副驾驶曾因极端观点被阿曼禁止飞行
global.summaryZh: 据知情人士透露，此前试图制造坠机事故的Flydubai副驾驶，曾因持有极端观点被阿曼禁止飞行。目前尚不清楚该航空公司在招聘时对其进行了何种背景调查。
global.whyImportant: 该事件暴露了航空公司在飞行员背景审查和跨国信息共享方面存在的严重漏洞。

global.title: Israeli air attack on Gaza City apartment kills at least five
global.summary: No warning was given before the deadly Israeli attack hit Remal, one of Gaza City's most crowded neighbourhoods.
global.titleZh: 以色列空袭加沙城公寓，造成至少五人死亡
global.summaryZh: 以色列在未发出预警的情况下，对加沙城人口稠密的雷马尔社区发动了空袭。此次袭击导致一栋公寓楼被毁，造成至少五人死亡。
global.whyImportant: 此次袭击进一步加剧了加沙地区的人道主义危机，并引发了国际社会对平民伤亡的强烈关注。

global.title: No more welcome mat? Japan’s tough visa rules spur foreign businesses to look elsewhere
global.summary: Five years ago, Sarah and her husband were optimistic about Japan’s economic future and were expanding their small businesses across several sectors. Today, that optimism has been replaced by concern over a sense of hostility towards two hard-working foreigners who feel they have contributed to the society that they have worked hard to fit into. New regulations that took effect on Thursday mean the two Britons, who have been in Japan for more than 10 years, now face significantly higher costs...
global.titleZh: 不再受欢迎？日本严苛的签证规定促使外国企业另寻他处
global.summaryZh: 日本近期实施的新签证法规大幅增加了长期居住外国人的成本，导致许多在日外籍人士感到被排斥。这一政策变化正促使部分外国企业和人才考虑离开日本市场。
global.whyImportant: 日本在试图吸引外资的同时收紧移民政策，可能对其经济增长和国际竞争力产生负面影响。

Geoscience Australia said it detected an earthquake with a preliminary magnitude of 4.8 at 2.01am near Leongatha, 130km south-east of Melbourne, with the tremors felt across the city’s eastern suburbs. global.titleZh: 维多利亚州发生4.8级地震，墨尔本震感明显
global.summaryZh: 维多利亚州于周六凌晨发生4.8级地震，震中位于墨尔本东南130公里的利昂加萨。当地居民在凌晨2点后感受到房屋震动，墨尔本东部郊区震感尤为明显。
global.whyImportant: 此次地震引发了当地居民的恐慌，并促使相关部门对震区基础设施进行安全评估。

global.title: Iran war live: Fighting intensifies in Yemen, hundreds killed or injured
global.summary: Fighting intensifies across Yemen as the army says 474 attacks in 24 hours killed or wounded 1,540 Houthi fighters.
global.titleZh: 伊朗战争直播：也门战斗升级，数百人伤亡
global.summaryZh: 也门境内冲突加剧，军方报告称在过去24小时内进行了474次袭击。此次行动导致1540名胡塞武装人员伤亡。
global.whyImportant: 也门战事的升级加剧了地区局势的不稳定性，并可能对中东地缘政治产生连锁反应。

The co-pilot was subsequently hired by the United Arab Emirates-based airline, the person said, speaking on the condition of anonymity to discuss the ongoing investigation. It was not immediately clear to what extent he was vetted when he was hired in the...
items.titleZh: Flydubai飞机袭击事件：副驾驶曾因极端观点被阿曼禁止飞行
items.summaryZh: 据知情人士透露，此前试图制造坠机事故的Flydubai副驾驶，曾因持有极端观点被阿曼禁止飞行。目前尚不清楚该航空公司在招聘时对其进行了何种背景调查。
items.whyImportant: 该事件暴露了航空公司在飞行员背景审查和跨国信息共享方面存在的严重漏洞。

items.title: Israeli air attack on Gaza City apartment kills at least five
items.summary: No warning was given before the deadly Israeli attack hit Remal, one of Gaza City's most crowded neighbourhoods.
items.titleZh: 以色列空袭加沙城公寓，造成至少五人死亡
items.summaryZh: 以色列在未发出预警的情况下，对加沙城人口稠密的雷马尔社区发动了空袭。此次袭击导致一栋公寓楼被毁，造成至少五人死亡。
items.whyImportant: 此次袭击进一步加剧了加沙地区的人道主义危机，并引发了国际社会对平民伤亡的强烈关注。

items.title: No more welcome mat? Japan’s tough visa rules spur foreign businesses to look elsewhere
items.summary: Five years ago, Sarah and her husband were optimistic about Japan’s economic future and were expanding their small businesses across several sectors. Today, that optimism has been replaced by concern over a sense of hostility towards two hard-working foreigners who feel they have contributed to the society that they have worked hard to fit into. New regulations that took effect on Thursday mean the two Britons, who have been in Japan for more than 10 years, now face significantly higher costs...
items.titleZh: 不再受欢迎？日本严苛的签证规定促使外国企业另寻他处
items.summaryZh: 日本近期实施的新签证法规大幅增加了长期居住外国人的成本，导致许多在日外籍人士感到被排斥。这一政策变化正促使部分外国企业和人才考虑离开日本市场。
items.whyImportant: 日本在试图吸引外资的同时收紧移民政策，可能对其经济增长和国际竞争力产生负面影响。

Geoscience Australia said it detected an earthquake with a preliminary magnitude of 4.8 at 2.01am near Leongatha, 130km south-east of Melbourne, with the tremors felt across the city’s eastern suburbs. items.titleZh: 维多利亚州发生4.8级地震，墨尔本震感明显
items.summaryZh: 维多利亚州于周六凌晨发生4.8级地震，震中位于墨尔本东南130公里的利昂加萨。当地居民在凌晨2点后感受到房屋震动，墨尔本东部郊区震感尤为明显。
items.whyImportant: 此次地震引发了当地居民的恐慌，并促使相关部门对震区基础设施进行安全评估。

items.title: Iran war live: Fighting intensifies in Yemen, hundreds killed or injured
items.summary: Fighting intensifies across Yemen as the army says 474 attacks in 24 hours killed or wounded 1,540 Houthi fighters.
items.titleZh: 伊朗战争直播：也门战斗升级，数百人伤亡
items.summaryZh: 也门境内冲突加剧，军方报告称在过去24小时内进行了474次袭击。此次行动导致1540名胡塞武装人员伤亡。
items.whyImportant: 也门战事的升级加剧了地区局势的不稳定性，并可能对中东地缘政治产生连锁反应。

items.title: China’s C919 jet faces further delivery delays amid US export chill: analysts
items.summary: A reported move by the United States to restrict exports of aircraft parts to China would place another speed bump on production of the C919 – a Chinese passenger jet designed to compete with Airbus and Boeing – as alternative sources of critical components for the plane are not readily available, according to analysts. The US Commerce Department has slowed export licensing for civilian aeroplane parts to China in recent weeks to strengthen Washington’s position in trade talks with Beijing,...
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 分析人士：受美国出口限制影响，中国C919客机交付面临进一步延误
items.summaryZh: 美国近期放缓了对华民用飞机零部件的出口许可审批，这给中国C919客机的生产带来了阻碍。由于缺乏现成的替代零部件来源，该机型的交付进度可能受到影响。
items.whyImportant: 此举显示了美国利用贸易政策作为谈判筹码，对中国航空制造业的供应链稳定性构成了直接挑战。

items.titleZh: 情况说明书：唐纳德·特朗普总统宣布为老年人提供医疗保险改善基金支付
items.summaryZh: 特朗普总统宣布联邦政府将向超过2000万名医疗保险受益人每人发放90美元，以帮助支付医疗保险B部分的保费。这是美国历史上首次动用该基金直接补贴老年人。
items.whyImportant: 此政策旨在通过直接经济补贴减轻老年人的医疗负担，具有显著的民生与政治意义。

items.title: Latin America sees China as more positive global influence than US: Poll
items.summary: Annual Latinobarometro survey finds views of China’s influence improving as perceptions of US influence worsen.

items.titleZh: 民调显示：拉美地区认为中国比美国具有更积极的全球影响力
items.summaryZh: 年度拉丁美洲晴雨表调查显示，拉美民众对中国影响力的看法有所改善，而对美国影响力的评价则有所下降。
items.whyImportant: 该民调反映了拉美地区地缘政治认知的转变，可能影响未来美国在该地区的战略布局。

items.title: NASA Astronaut Christina Koch to Join NFL Fans in Philadelphia
items.summary: As part of NASA’s ongoing Inspiration Tour, NASA astronaut Christina Koch will highlight America’s strengths in space exploration and aeronautics innovation at the Philadelphia Eagles vs. Los Angeles Rams game in Philadelphia on Sunday, Oct. 4. A self-proclaimed Philadelphia sports fan, Koch is an explorer and engineer who spent a total of 338 days in […]

items.titleZh: NASA宇航员克里斯蒂娜·科赫将与费城NFL球迷见面
items.summaryZh: 作为NASA“灵感之旅”的一部分，宇航员克里斯蒂娜·科赫将在费城老鹰队对阵洛杉矶公羊队的比赛中亮相。她将借此机会展示美国在太空探索和航空创新方面的成就。
items.whyImportant: 通过体育赛事进行科普宣传，是NASA提升公众对航天事业关注度与支持度的重要手段。

items.title: Panama auditor targets ex-port regulators and CK Hutchison’s executives in canal probe
items.summary: Panama’s comptroller general said on Friday that his office would send prosecutors more audit material on former executives of CK Hutchison’s local subsidiary next week, as part of a criminal investigation into the Hong Kong conglomerate’s annulled Panama Canal ports concession. Speaking at the Atlantic Council in Washington, Anel Flores said prosecutors had requested documents concerning Panama Ports Company (PPC), the operator of the Balboa and Cristobal terminals at either end of the canal...

items.titleZh: 巴拿马审计机构针对前港口监管机构及长江和记高管展开运河调查
items.summaryZh: 巴拿马审计长表示，将向检察官提交更多关于长江和记当地子公司前高管的审计材料。此举是针对该港口特许经营权被撤销一案的刑事调查的一部分。
items.whyImportant: 此项调查涉及跨国企业的海外运营合规性，可能对相关企业的国际声誉及后续业务产生法律影响。
